info.title: AuditFlow API
info.description: Generated from AuditFlow v2.1 route contract registry. A route is not implementation-complete until operation ID, auth/session behavior, exact authorization predicate, path/query/body schemas, success/error responses, idempotency, concurrency, audit event declaration, and rate-limit policy are present and contract-tested.
